integrity: The all-graph statement is proved symbolically by matching graph leaf deletion with two explicit Stong beat-point deletions and then proving the resulting poset minimal. Search non-detection is treated as residual originality risk rather than novelty proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for nonempty finite simple graphs and their incidence posets. It does not cover loops, parallel edges, higher-dimensional face posets, or arbitrary height-two posets. The finite regression checks graphs through six vertices and is not used as the infinite proof.
title: Graph 2-cores classify Stong cores of incidence posets
